title: Ungulate vocalizations and production context
publisher: Zenodo; originating researchers: Lefèvre, Romain Adrien (University of Copenhagen); Sypherd, Ciara Cleo-Rose (Harvard University); Mandel-Briefer, Élodie Floriane (University of Copenhagen)
deterministic_selection_rule: Complete SoundsDatabase.zip and Data S1.zip; all seven species and 3181 recorded calls retained.

measurement_dates.description: Multiple original studies and acquisition periods, not one 2025 recording campaign. Deposit 2025.
measurement_dates.status: documented where explicit; otherwise unknown, never inferred from release

author_preprocessing: Extracted/segmented animal contact calls rather than continuous microphone streams; source contextual labels and original filenames are retained. The source spelling WidlBoar is not corrected.
known_analyses_and_limitations: The source study is DOI 10.1016/j.isci.2025.111834 (PMC11847267). Valence is a context-derived label, not direct access to animal internal state. Animal, study and recording conditions may confound acoustic associations.
